scientific_integrity: Proof supplies global convergence, exact budget and sharp first-entrance coefficient; finite numerical diagnostics are not substitutes for infinite-time arguments.
scientific_limitations: Requires identical natural frequencies and exact quadrature interaction/adaptation lags. The phase-barrier entrance-time uniformity assumes bounded initial coupling asymmetry. No perturbative or large-network extension is proved. Literature priority is provisional against unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Exact phase basins and logarithmic barrier delay in a quadrature adaptive oscillator pair
